title: 第15章 剑噬煎熬第16章 青锋碎石
lines: 云澈强行挤出一个比哭还难看的笑容，感觉自己的声音像是从喉咙眼里硬挤出来的，带着点自己都没察觉的颤音，
“可能是有点累了，刚才精神太集中。
林兄的剑法果然玄妙，让我受益匪浅，需要……需要好好消化一下。”
他感觉自己快要撑不住了。
脑子里像是有一万只发了疯的毒蜂在同时振翅，尖锐的嗡鸣几乎要刺破耳膜，更可怕的是那种仿佛要将灵魂撕成碎片的剧痛，正一波强过一波地席卷而来。
他必须立刻“独处”
，否则下一秒就可能当着林虎的面瘫倒抽搐。
林虎看他脸色白得跟纸一样，额头上瞬间沁出的冷汗在昏暗光线下都反光了，以为他真是观摩剑法消耗过度——毕竟高深剑意对心神负担大，他是知道的。
这憨直的汉子顿时有点不好意思，挠了挠头：
“哦哦，那你快歇着！
千万别硬撑！
我这破剑法没啥好看的，等你缓过来，咱们再聊！”
云澈几乎是从牙缝里挤出这个字，再也顾不上客套，扶着冰冷的石壁，脚步有些虚浮地挪到洞穴更里面一个相对阴暗的角落，背对着林虎，缓缓坐了下来。
刚一坐下，他整个身体就控制不住地微微颤抖起来，只能拼命咬紧牙关，不让自己发出任何声音。
“娘的，这次……怎么这么猛……”
云澈心里叫苦不迭。
这次的剑噬，跟之前拓印谷里那些死气沉沉的残剑完全不是一个量级！
如果说之前是有人拿锤子敲他的头，那这次感觉就是整个脑袋被塞进了锻压机底下，还在被持续加力！
眼前已经不是发黑，而是开始冒出各种扭曲、破碎的光影，耳边除了嗡鸣，似乎还夹杂着无数凄厉的剑鸣和模糊的嘶吼，搅得他意识都快涣散了。
最让他感到恐惧的是，他发现自己对《青锋三式》的记忆，正在变得模糊！
就像硬盘遇到了坏道，某些关键的运劲技巧、招式变化，突然就想不起来了，或者变得极其滞涩陌生！
这种“失去”
的感觉，比肉体上的疼痛更让他心慌。
“不行……不能失去……那是我现在保命的根本……”
一股巨大的恐慌攫住了他。
他拼命在脑海中观想《青锋三式》的起手式，却感觉那图像支离破碎，难以凝聚。
就在他感觉自己的意识快要被痛苦彻底淹没的时候，忽然想起了一样东西——剑髓石！
那块从疣猪肚子里找到的、仅有的小碎片！
如同溺水之人抓住了最后一根稻草，云澈用尽最后的力气，颤抖着手从怀里摸出那个小心包裹着的小石块。
也顾不得会不会被林虎发现异常了，他紧紧将石头攥在手心，再次尝试引导其中那丝微弱的能量。
清凉的气流再次出现，虽然比第一次吸收时微弱了许多，但这股能量如同甘霖，精准地浇灌在他那仿佛快要燃烧起来的灵魂之上。
剧痛依然存在，却不再是无边无际的黑暗吞噬，而是有了一个清晰的、可以忍受的“阈值”
那股清凉感护住了他灵台的最后一点清明，让他没有彻底崩溃。
“有用……真的有用……”
云澈心中涌起一股劫后余生的庆幸。
他不敢有丝毫松懈，全力引导着这丝宝贵的能量，对抗着脑海中的风暴。
时间在这一刻变得无比漫长。
每一秒都像是在刀尖上跳舞。
他蜷缩在角落里，身体因为极致的痛苦而时不时地痉挛一下，牙齿咬得咯咯作响，指甲因为用力而深深抠进身下的泥土里。
汗水早已湿透全身，让他看起来像是刚从水里捞出来。
content_en:
"No...it's okay."
Yun Che forced out a smile that was uglier than crying. He felt as if his voice was forced out of his throat, with a vibrato that he didn't even notice.
"Maybe I'm a little tired, I was too focused just now.
Brother Lin's swordsmanship is indeed mysterious and has benefited me a lot. I need to... need to digest it. "
He felt like he couldn't hold on any longer.
It felt like ten thousand crazy poisonous bees were flapping their wings at the same time in my mind, and the sharp buzzing almost pierced my eardrums. What was even more terrifying was the severe pain that seemed to tear my soul into pieces, sweeping over me in waves stronger than the others.
He must be "alone" immediately
, otherwise he might collapse and twitch in front of Lin Hu in the next second.
Lin Hu saw that his face was as white as paper, and the cold sweat that broke out on his forehead was reflected in the dim light. He thought that he had spent too much on observing the swordsmanship - after all, he knew that advanced swordsmanship was very taxing on the mind.
This honest man suddenly felt a little embarrassed and scratched his head:
"Oh, then take a rest!
Don't hold on!
There's nothing interesting about my bad swordsmanship. Let's talk again when you calm down! "
"good"
Yun Che almost squeezed out the word through his teeth. He no longer cared about being polite. He supported the cold stone wall and moved to a relatively dark corner further inside the cave with a somewhat vain pace. He turned his back to Lin Hu and slowly sat down.
As soon as he sat down, his whole body began to tremble uncontrollably, and he could only grit his teeth desperately to prevent himself from making any sound.
"Damn, this time... why are you so fierce..."
Yun Che complained endlessly in his heart.
The sword bite this time is completely different from the lifeless broken swords in the Rubbing Valley before!
If someone hit him on the head with a hammer before, this time it felt like his entire head was stuffed under the forging press and was being continuously pressed!
His eyes were no longer black, but various distorted and broken lights and shadows began to emerge. In addition to the buzzing in his ears, there seemed to be countless shrill sword sounds and vague roars, which made him almost lose consciousness.
What frightened him the most was that he found that his memory of "Qingfeng Three Styles" was becoming blurred!
Just like a hard drive encountering bad sectors, some key movement skills and moves suddenly cannot be remembered, or become extremely sluggish and unfamiliar!
This "loss"
The feeling made him more flustered than the physical pain.
"No...can't lose...that's the basis for my life now..."
A great panic seized him.
He tried his best to visualize the starting position of "Qingfeng Three Styles" in his mind, but he felt that the image was fragmented and difficult to condense.
Just when he felt that his consciousness was about to be completely overwhelmed by pain, he suddenly remembered something - the sword marrow stone!
The only tiny fragment found in a warthog's belly!
Like a drowning man grabbing the last straw, Yun Che used his last strength and trembling hands to take out the carefully wrapped small stone from his arms.
Not caring whether Lin Hu would notice anything unusual, he held the stone tightly in his hand and tried to channel the weak energy in it again.
The cool air flow appeared again, although it was much weaker than the first time he absorbed it, but this energy was like rain, pouring accurately on his soul that seemed to be about to burn.
The severe pain still exists, but it is no longer the endless darkness swallowing up, but has a clear and tolerable "threshold"
That cool feeling protected the last bit of clarity in his spiritual platform, preventing him from completely collapsing.
"It's useful...it's really useful..."
Yun Che felt a surge of joy in his heart that he had survived the disaster.
He did not dare to relax at all, and directed this precious energy with all his strength to fight against the storm in his mind.
Time became extremely long at this moment.
Every second is like dancing on the edge of a knife.
He huddled in the corner, his body spasming from time to time due to the extreme pain, his teeth clenched, and his nails dug deeply into the soil beneath him due to the force.
Sweat had already soaked his body, making him look like he had just been fished out of the water.
title_en: Chapter 15 Sword Bite Suffering Chapter 16 Qingfeng Rubble
